kind: measured implementation weight and consumer feedback

identityQuality.attemptLookupSuccess: every real-attempt lookup by canonical AttemptId succeeded; the selector uses the canonical Work event's entity_id plus event type and project id
identityQuality.sessionBindingMissing: all real product attempts — SESSION_UNBOUND, because no Attempt→Session producer exists
identityQuality.sessionBindingLocalOnly: every real attempt with a host observation (BOUND_LOCAL_ONLY)
identityQuality.sessionBindingConflict: 1 (measured with a reader whose header names a different session)
identityQuality.wrongSourceRejections: the CONFLICT control refused a header mismatch, and the SESSION_MISSING control refused an absent id
identityQuality.duplicateSourceHandling: AMBIGUOUS is a first-class state; no candidate is ever picked by convenience

readCompleteness.executionEventsAvailable: a real DSH session read returned a bounded page (50 of 37-75 known events depending on the session); the ruled vocabulary is present in real logs
canonicalWorkFactsAvailable: historical world basis digest and captured-at revision
readCompleteness.unresolvedRelationships: reported in projectContext.unresolvedReferences; empty in the real non-model scenarios because those histories contain no cross-owner ground
readCompleteness.missingOrStaleSources: reported in caveats.sourcesUnavailable, caveats.missingSession and projectContext.currentnessCaveats

fieldsRequiringTheOriginalOwner: verification state — V0 reports NOT_OBSERVED_BY_V0 rather than reading the verification plane
the reasoning/proof/workspace bases — read by T0 but presented only as coverage and caveats
additionalDataThatWouldMateriallyImprove: a durable Attempt→DSH Session binding, which would let the execution half be authoritative rather than caller-requested
the verification owner's verdict, so canonical.verificationState becomes a real fact
a T0 exact Ground verifier, so the quarantined cross-owner relations become selectable
fieldsPresentButNotObviousToAConsumer: attempt.historicalAuthorization.basisDigest — useful only to a consumer that can resolve a basis digest
projectContext.projectionSemanticDigest — useful for reproducibility checks, not for reading

operationalCost.ownerReadsPerPreview: 1 Work event-list read, 1 attempt record read, 1 basis resolution, 1 promotion-facts read, plus 1 T0 projection build (which itself reads the Work history once and each referenced cross-owner scope)
operationalCost.dshSessionReadsPerPreview: 1 header read and 1 bounded event read when a session is claimed; 0 otherwise
operationalCost.localNonModelTestTime: the real-stack test files complete in roughly 15-60 s each on this machine; the DSH source tests in roughly 37 s
operationalCost.changedExistingInterfaces: src/trajectory/index.ts — additive exports only; the public package API check reports 0 added names because src/trajectory is not re-exported from the package entries

decisionFramework.capability: read a DSH session's events and header identity
decisionFramework.reason: readColdSessionLog and the JSONL backend are first-party and reachable; no new code was needed beyond a thin adapter

decisionFramework.capability: inspect a Work Attempt's canonical facts
decisionFramework.reason: the Work owner and the T0 projection already provide every canonical fact V0 presents

decisionFramework.capability: combine both views into one read model
decisionFramework.reason: one composition adapter (507 lines) plus two semantic modules; no storage, no scheduler

decisionFramework.capability: bind a Work Attempt to a DSH Session durably
decisionFramework.reason: no producer exists; V0 records the requirement rather than creating the store
host jobs are deliberately ephemeral; a durable host lifecycle would be a new persistence decision, deferred until a consumer needs it

decisionFramework.capability: raw event inspection / full transcript view
decisionFramework.reason: the default Preview must not expose raw content; a future separately-authorized capability is the right shape

decisionFramework.capability: an exact T0 cross-owner Ground verifier
decisionFramework.reason: the quarantined relations are not needed by this consumer; fixing them would be another T0 reconstruction framework

strongBindingRequirementIfNeeded.producer: the host/deployment boundary (the worker port already knows the child it spawned and the attempt it prepared for)
strongBindingRequirementIfNeeded.authority: host-local lifecycle metadata — not a canonical Work fact and not a new owner
strongBindingRequirementIfNeeded.lifecycle: written at spawn, readable after exit, lost on host restart
strongBindingRequirementIfNeeded.failureSemantics: a missing binding degrades to SESSION_UNBOUND, never to a guess
